scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @todolist/api" "npm run dev --workspace @todolist/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @todolist/api && npm run test --workspace @todolist/web
scripts.format: prettier --write . && python -m ruff check --select I --fix . && python -m ruff format . && python scripts/harness/sync_agent_harness.py
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && python -m ruff check --select I . && python -m ruff format --check . && python scripts/harness/sync_agent_harness.py --check
